t.why: It generates most of its electricity from renewables and is often held up as a model for environmental policy.
t.rel: The country that abolished its army in 1948. It has had a dispute with neighboring Nicaragua over a border river, and is considered Central America's most stable democracy.
t.know: The greeting 'pura vida' sums up a culture that values an easygoing life.
t.etext: It built up high-tech manufacturing such as medical devices and chip parts by attracting foreign companies. Bananas, pineapples, coffee and ecotourism are big too. It makes most of its electricity from renewables.
